groups.sentence: Instructors have a clear policy on AI use so that students are supported.
Instructors tell students at the start of the course that they will not use AI to grade their work.
Instructors do not use AI to grade or assign grades for student work.
Instructors review student work and confirm that grades are accurate, consistent and explainable from the student's evidence.
Instructors do not rely only on AI for grading or assessment; AI-only grading without human review is unethical.
Where AI assists assessment, instructors keep human oversight of grading and feedback, with transparency.
Students have the right to request human review of AI-assisted assessment.
Grades without proper instructor review could be successfully appealed by students.
Instructors remain responsible and accountable for final grades and evaluative judgments.
Everyone must not let AI make the final decision on matters needing human judgment, such as grades, admissions or hiring.
